title: Part 62 : 2023: Petroleum and its Products - Methods of Test Part 62 Heat Stability of Greases
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes two methods of test for determination of heat stability of lime base, soda base and soda-lime mixed base greases. The Method A is applicable for lime base greases and the Method B is applicable for soda base and soda-lime mixed base greases.
clause_3_terminology: Methods of Test Part 62 Heat Stability of Greases
Part 62 : 2023: Petroleum and its Products - Methods of Test Part 62 Heat Stability of Greases

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
